description: Based around Padstow and its working coast, Rick explores the fishermen, shellfish, local rituals and restaurant craft behind his seafood cooking, moving from practical fish preparation to dishes inspired by Cornwall and the wider world.

s01e01.description: Rick begins around Padstow with the fishermen, shellfish and restaurant kitchen that shaped his approach to seafood, preparing fish soup, crab Newburg, scallops and red mullet with a Tuscan-style sauce.

s01e02.description: Razor shells and clam chowder lead into a reunion with turbot and hollandaise, while mackerel, mushrooms and John Dory show how much can be done with impeccably fresh fish.

s01e03.description: The restaurant team heads outdoors for a clam bake and follows the shoreline in search of shellfish, including a nocturnal hunt for soft-shell crab and the simple cooking that suits such fresh ingredients.

s01e04.description: As the Seafood Restaurant attracts increasing attention, Rick balances a photo session and the demands of the kitchen with practical seafood cooking, including fish cakes and dishes designed around the day's catch.

s01e05.description: Rick crosses the Channel to compare British and French attitudes to fish, joins a fishing trip for the so-called king of the sea, and turns the day's seafood into an unfussy salad shaped by tide and season.

s01e06.description: Padstow's May Day traditions frame the finale as Rick cooks for friends and neighbours, pairing local lobster with a hot, aromatic Thai-style dressing while the town prepares for its annual celebration.
